title: Mixed Event — It's On! Wonder Halloween!

meta.Outline: Tsukasa and the rest of WxS begin preparing a Halloween performance for Phoenix Wonderland's Show Contest. However, Rui starts acting unusual after an incident...

rows.Line: Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay... I think I have everything I need for today.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, I could use those lights for the final scene too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Time to put on another fantastic show!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Argh!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That flash of light... What was it?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You remember now, don't you, Black Knight? You used to wield your sword to protect people, to keep peace.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So those shinies were his memories coming back? It looked so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're right... I'd forgotten what was really important to me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I shall vow to only ever brandish my sword in the name of peace as I had in the past!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The Black Knight was once again back on the righteous path and peace returned to the world.
bgm_area00004

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What a terrific story!
Maybe I could play a part too♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! I'm not surprised!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The light effect at the end deserves a special mention. It was a very clever lighting scheme!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, so it was worth the effort.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And the part where Tsukasa leaps almost up to the ceiling was so awesome♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I loved that bit too! You shot up like a rocket, Tsukasa! It was so cool♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I thought he was going to go through the roof.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, yes. Being lifted up by hidden wires...
To be honest, I was scared senseless.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But you need to challenge yourself to make extraordinary performances! And I aim to be the world's greatest star!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If it's for the sake of entertaining my audience, I'll pull off even the most dangerous stunts with elegance and grace!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, well, it's certainly great to have a reliable guy such as yourself on the team.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm thinking of adding in a new part, especially for a star of your caliber. What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, a new part...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What sort of thing do you have in mind? Is it gonna be fun?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I have a bad feeling about this...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Don't worry, I've made due considerations for health and safety. Although that performance may require some courage.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, guys!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hmm?
Who's that?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That's Len!
Hey, Leeen!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Like... Kagamine Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yup, that's me!
Nice to meet you all♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I was coming to see your show, but on the way here, I saw some plushies having an argument.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: By the time I got them to calm down and make up, the show was over! I'm so gutted that I missed it...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I was wondering where you were.
It's a pity you couldn't make it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hmm... I feel sorry for Len missing out.
Why don't we do another performance for him?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
YEESSS!
I'll even do it a hundred times!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A hundred might be a bit much...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I suppose we could do it once more. It'll be good practice...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Then it's settled!
Feast your eyes on our wonderful show!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Awesome!
Everyone, thank you so much!
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Aah, I had TONS of fun!
And Len really liked our show too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. We also got some pointers for improvement.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our big performance tomorrow is guaranteed to be a resounding success!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I'm sure it will go without a hitch... It might be time to start thinking of what our next show after that will be.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Already?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Why not? I already have some new ideas to play around with to make our next show even more entertaining.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Is that possible?!
I'm so hyped♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You'll have me doing even trickier stunts, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Shouldn't you be pleased? It'll give you the attention you so badly crave, Mr. Self-proclaimed Star.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I think you meant to say acclaimed star!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It's going to be so amazing, Tsukasa!
Every show Rui comes up with is so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Fun, yes... But I'd rather not have a jetpack strapped to my back again, or anything like that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Not your cup of tea, Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It would make for a truly fantastic spectacle, worthy of a true star such as...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, fine...!
I'll do whatever you need me to do!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If it's to put on a good show, then I'll do anything!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As long as you can promise me that whatever antics you have me do will make the audience roar with delight.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, you can be sure of that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's definitely going to be a crowd-pleaser of the highest caliber.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ascending to the stage from the seats won't have enough of an impact. He needs to make a powerful impression as a knight...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, I've got it! That will definitely be better! But I'll have to assess its practicality and safety first.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You look like you've been having the time of your life lately.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, have I?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah. You look like you're having fun.
Before, you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What do you mean, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You seemed bored all the time before, but now you keep making this weird face.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How is it weird? Should I be concerned?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Jokes aside, you may be right...
I'm finally living my life.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Being able to put my ideas into action feels amazing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyways, the stage is sorted and we're ready to hold our show. I'll start planning the next one in the meantime.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... Maybe I can make it easier for Tsukasa by reusing some of the gimmicks that worked with him last time.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I'm happy for you, Rui.
The next day
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright! Let's get started with the rehearsal...!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Miss!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: A notice about an event that's to be held here just came in...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
An event?
Dad didn't mention anything about that...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What sort of event is it?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Here's the flyer.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Let's see...
The First Phoenix Show Contest...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Did you just say Show Contest...?!
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
A Show Contest?
This is my first time hearing anything about that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So it's really happening...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, what do you mean by that...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I thought this would be your kind of thing.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, umm...! It's just that there was talk about holding a contest at one point!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But it never got anywhere because Grandpa said, There's no need to compete to be the best. Everyone is different and that's the way it should be.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So this news is a bit of a surprise for me...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In other words, this is a sudden change in policy...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A contest. I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's right up my alley!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whaaa?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Lower your voice...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This contest will reveal which shows by which groups are the most magnificent!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is my chance to shine as a star performer, then my talent as a leader will become known far and wide!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hehehe... And maybe, just maybe... This theme park will earn recognition worldwide thanks to this!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay, okay, we got it.
Just keep it down, will you?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Don't act as if this doesn't concern you too, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This could be a big step towards fulfilling your dream of becoming a musical actress!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well... I guess it might help.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Aaand, more popularity means we'll have a bigger budget for awesome stage gear, which will make our shows just that much better!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm. I usually just construct what we need out stuff that's lying around... But I won't say no to having more funds.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Uh, yeah... The more shows we do, the more people we can make happy...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: An event like this is a rare occasion, so we should join in and enjoy it♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If Emu's up for it, I have no objections.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Great! What do we need to do to participate?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It says here, Phoenix Wonderland is delighted to announce that it will be hosting an exciting competition to determine which of its performing groups is the best.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Each group is to stage three shows during the event period. The audience will vote for their favorite each time as these groups compete to receive the most votes...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, I see. If it were only one show, the audience might pick based on a show's theme, so they want to vote in three separate parts.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: By the way, how many stages does this park have?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
10 if you include the small ones♪
And there's a group for every stage!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There's that many?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How did you land a job here with zero knowledge...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wait, there's more?
In addition...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The winners will be featured in a TV commercial promoting Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wha...?! We could be in a commercial?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So I was right. Winning this contest is going to pave the road to stardom!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm not sure about the whole stardom part...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But taking part in this challenge and performing in front of a bigger audience than we've ever had could be a good learning experience.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I agree!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, it sounds like everyone's on board. Let's start working on a new show for this contest!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!
The next day

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Here we are! Our first order of business is to decide what our show for the competition will be about!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Since we really need to win our audience over, it should be something showy, memorable and fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I know! Let's make it about THAT!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Brilliant suggestion. I believe that will do beautifully.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, what are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: THAT! You know? When you go around with everyone at night, get scared and stuff, and it's super fun!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I have no idea! Just say it already!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Err... It's called...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Halloween! It's Halloween!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Halloween?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... I see.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A Halloween show can be over the top in a good way. It has the potential to become a hit with the audience.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! And we can have lots of spooky stuff too! Like jack-o-lanterns, zombies, giant spiders and...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: L-Let's leave spiders out of it...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I like the idea.
It's different and sounds fun.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
J-J-Just without any spiders, okay?
I still like the Halloween theme so...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's do a Halloween show!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! Awesome!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then how does an adaptation of Potato Ghosts sound?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Potato Ghosts?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's not that well-known, I suppose.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: On the night of Halloween, spirits of the dead invade an amusement park after seeing the living enjoying themselves. It seems a night of terror is about to begin...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But the park director welcomes the ghosts and invites them to join the Halloween festivities. The living and the dead end up celebrating together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: One after another, the ghosts rise from the ground like potatoes from a harvest and serve as the namesake theme of this play.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What a cool story! I love it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A play based on that story is sure to be a riot! It fits this park and the spirit of Halloween perfectly!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I like it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright! Let's divide the roles and start preparing. We're going to snag victory with this one. I feel it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hopefully. However, I will need your help with something if you don't mind, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sure, what is it?
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We lift on three.
One... Two... Three!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oof!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! Is that a trap door in the middle?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hack! Cough! It's so dusty...!
How did you know there was this space?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I found it by chance when tidying up.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It was probably used as storage for stage equipment.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
A lucky find, wouldn't you say?
We can use it as a trap room.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What's that?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A room beneath the stage that actors can use as an entrance or exit.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For example, I can hide one of my zombie robots here for when the play starts.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That can be where the story will reach its first climax as the zombie robot rise and make their appearance.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It'll be like they dug themselves out of the ground up, see?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The protagonist, Tsukasa, will fly into a panic and try to run away, but more zombie robots will appear from the seats to surround him...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There is no escape... And Tsukasa will be dragged into the trap room.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's how I envision it. What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ooh! That sounds awesome!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... Not bad. The more hair-raising the scene is, the more dramatic the plot twist will be!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But you have to build the robots by yourself, Rui. Are you sure you can make them in time...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, but I already finished one.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Already?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I started building it as soon as I got this idea yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That explains the huge suitcase I saw you hauling around this morning.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, we can start rehearsing right away?! Yay! Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We can do a test run with my zombie robot while going over the main points of the play.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay. For this one, your robot drags me away to the trap room, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I put a mat down there so you'll have a soft landing. The robot has built-in safety features, so there's no need to worry.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Good luck, Tsukasa!!

rows.Speaker: Zombie Robot
rows.Line: Augh... Augh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yikes... I know it's just a robot but I'm still a bit creeped out...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Are you ready?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yeah! Here I go!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Stop! I'm the director! You cannot treat me like this!

rows.Speaker: Zombie Robot
rows.Line: Augh... Augh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Stop... No... NOOO!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe... Nice.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. It went very smoothly.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thanks, Tsukasa!
That was perfect.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You think so?
A top performance from a top star!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay, I'm going to climb back out.
Heave-ho!

rows.Speaker: Zombie Robot
rows.Line: Augh... Augh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Why is my robot still moving...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Argh! Let go of my clothes!
No, I'm gonna...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Aaargh!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Tsukasa?!
He fell back in!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: There's a mat on the floor, but... Are you okay?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasaaa! He's not waking up! What do we do?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is bad... Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Gasp!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He's awake!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thank goodness!
Are you okay, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What... What happened?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The robot grabbed your clothes and you fell back into the trap room. Thankfully, you landed on the mat...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, Tsukasa.
My robot seems to have malfunctioned...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was convinced my safety features were foolproof but... It's all my fault.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That could've ended really badly for me, you know!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But accidents happen...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Next time, I'll make sure to be more careful too. I'd never forgive myself if an incident like this happened during a show and terrified our audience.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To be clear, I think this dramatic scene is great! This is the kind of stuff I want to see more from you, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You okay...?
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay, team!
Let's start our first full rehearsal!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But are you sure you're okay?
Doesn't it still hurt?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You hit your head pretty hard, so take it easy. We don't want to make you worse than you already are.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Are you worried about me or just mocking me...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm fine! I got checked out at a hospital just to be sure.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's focus on the rehearsal today, okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: If you're REALLY sure you're okay... Let's get started!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
We're going to do a read-through first, right?
Rui, you said you'd bring us copies of the script.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui? Hello?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Sorry, what was that? Ah, the script.
Here are your copies! Ready to go?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Director! We have a remarkably large audience today!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh? Excellent!
Let's see what sort of demographic it is this time... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Am... Am I seeing this right?
Are these creatures...crawling out of graves?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Could they be... No, they DEFINITELY are zombies! And they're headed this way!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yikes, you're right!
And they don't smell very nice either!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's not the problem! Goodness me, we must evacuate our visitors at once!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Before the zombies get them, that is!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: At this point Tsukasa makes his way to the center of the audience seats while addressing the guests as he passes them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Run away! Run away!
Zombies are coming!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Next, he faces the oncoming zombies and...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, er... He should turn back and return to the stage. Then he says his next line....

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hold on, isn't that kind of anticlimactic?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
This is the first scene with the zombies.
It needs to have more of an impact.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I suppose so...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How about I fight the zombies?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Cooool!
I wanna fight too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That could work. Tsukasa could struggle as he tries to fight one zombie and the audience will know that these are formidable opponents.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes... We could have that. And while he's struggling with the one zombie, a whole throng of them can appear from the other side...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa dashes back towards the stage, the zombies close ranks and the audience will hold their breath.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah! Everyone's eyes will be glued to me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And then? What happens next?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Just when the zombies are about to catch him, Tsukasa performs a miraculous leap!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, it's wire-flying time!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He somersaults in the air and flies past his pursuers...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's going to look INCREDIBLE♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is just the kind of daring performance I was born for! What comes after that, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Actually... This might be too much action so early in the play. It'll throw off the pacing.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I need to give it some more thought. Let's leave it for now and move on to the next scene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sooo... The next scene is where I get dragged away into the trap room!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We had a bit of an accident last time, but I'll pull it off without a hitch this time!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: About that scene...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd like to tweak it a little.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In what way?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Disappearing into the trap room creates a problem where the audience can't see what's happening.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It would be better if zombies appeared at the far side of the stage and you'll find yourself cornered.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You can still act the being dragged underground part, just you'll be doing it while in the full view of the audience. Don't you think that would be better?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, it's not bad but...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Are you sure you're happy with just that...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our Halloween show deserves to be more original than that. I'm fired up for it and really want to outdo myself.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There's nothing wrong with pantomiming it but it's going to take away from the realism we're trying to create.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, zombies emerging from beneath the stage gives it a real sense of danger!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's have TEN zombies gang up on me and pull me under for a powerful and dramatic effect!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That many? It sounds risky, especially since you nearly got hurt last time we tried it with just one.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That was due to my carelessness. Don't worry, I can do this! The audience will be even more thrilled if it looks a little dangerous!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What do you think, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I don't think it would be visually appealing.
We should keep the action on the stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's go with the change I mentioned earlier... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
What is it?
Did I say something strange?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Not strange, but...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It's just that...
You don't sound like yourself.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I don't...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm. I'm not doing anything out of the ordinary. How am I acting different from usual?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's hard to put my finger on it, but...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, Rui...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is this honestly what you want from this show?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
What do you mean?
Is this what I want from this show...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wouldn't be expending my energy on something I don't intend on doing.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. That's the kind of person you are. You wouldn't be doing something if you didn't really want to...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, you've been directing differently as compared to usual.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Differently...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm making adjustments to ensure that the audience feels just as frightened as the park director does here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's something you would say too...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But it's clear that this isn't what you actually want to do.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You seemed to be really enjoying yourself the first time you talked to me about using the trap room...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But since we had that accident, the spark from your eyes has gone.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The way you've been telling me how this or that would be better for the audience sounds like you trying to persuade yourself.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Am I wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm trying to persuade myself...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, but I'm not.
I do believe this is the best way to go.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Quit lying!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: T-Tsukasa...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You've been peeling back on what you want to do because I got hurt last time!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But you have me mistaken, Tsukasa.
I... I'm making changes to improve the show...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And I'm telling you to quit lying like that!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I told you that I'm going to make the most of the role you've given me. I'll pull off whatever you throw at me, no matter how tricky it might be!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We have the potential to put on a jaw-dropping show, but you're holding back!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm not holding back! How many times do I have to repeat myself like this?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: S... STOP!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Will you two stop fighting?! Please...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
You two need to cool off.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm sorry I raised my voice...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But Rui isn't himself today.
It's clear as day.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How can that...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We both need to clear our heads...
This show won't be going anywhere otherwise.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll see you later.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh, you're leaving?
Tsukasa, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Do you think so too, Nene...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Am I acting differently than normal?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yes.
There's something off about you today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
You seemed to be having a great time lately.
There was this glint in your eyes...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But now it's gone.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I don't really know what to do...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I never thought I would try to cut corners when it came to producing a show...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But according to you and Tsukasa, that's what I've been doing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Rui seems to be completely oblivious to the fact that he's holding back because he's worried.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have to help him realize that.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I couldn't do anything back then either... Will it be any different this time?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(No, I need to do something.
If I don't, he'll end up all by himself again.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui, why don't we go over to SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Let's visit Miku and her friends for some advice.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Asking for tips about our shows is one thing, but personal troubles...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I don't even know how to put my problem into words.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But you feel that if things continue like this, we won't be able to put on a worthwhile show, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think Tsukasa got so worked up because he saw this too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Miku and the others always lend us an ear.
Let's go and talk to them about this.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Don't you want to do this show together and make it the best it can be?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, I understand. Let's go, Nene.
bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Easy now...! Let's all take a deep breath! Give each other some space too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What's going on here? Len? Miku?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I organized a show for the plushies, but they started fighting again.

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line:
I want to make the show better!
Why aren't you letting me?!

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line: But you'll get hurt if you do something like that!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, don't do that! Stop!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh my. They've become quite the handful.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah... But I guess it was unavoidable.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh? Why do you say that?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I realized something while I was making this show. It's too easy to get worked up and fixated on your own ideas for making a performance great, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And that your ideas might conflict with someone else's...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, that is true.
Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Isn't that Rui and Nene over there?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
They seem a little down.
I wonder what happened...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You guys wait here.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'll go and talk to them.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Can you come with me, plushies?
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: C'mon! I can do better than this!

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line: No, it's too dangerous...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see... So that's what brought you here.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
I'm at a loss as to what to do.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm not consciously holding back or anything either...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Holding back...?
Has this ever happened before?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, not really.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If anything, I've always done the opposite.

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: And for the finale, we'll all jump down from the wall. How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Friend A
rows.Line: It does sound fun... But it also seems a little dangerous.

rows.Speaker: Friend B
rows.Line: I don't want to end up getting hurt or anything...

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: But it's going to be fun...! Everyone watching will love it and we can even place a trampoline for us to land on!

rows.Speaker: Friend A
rows.Line:
Ask someone else.
I'm not doing it.

rows.Speaker: Friend B
rows.Line: Me neither. If I get hurt, my mom will get so mad at me.

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That paints a vivid picture...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There were a few kids who would get excited about my ideas.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But sooner or later, even they became fed up with me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It kept happening again and again. Eventually there was no one left that wanted anything to do with me.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Nene
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, Nene.
It's been a while...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Rui
rows.Line: I heard you're going to be the lead for a show. Congratulations!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Nene
rows.Line: Oh, yeah. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Nene
rows.Line: And, um... How are you...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Rui
rows.Line: I'm working on a solo project... But I haven't found anyone else like you that's willing to help.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Nene
rows.Line: Then would you like to join the troupe I'm in...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Nene
rows.Line: I mean, uh...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. It's nice of you to invite me, but there's no need to pity me. I'm doing okay on my own, and it's for the best anyway.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Rui
rows.Line: I've got to go. I still have plenty of work left for my show. Good luck with yours, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Nene
rows.Line: R-Rui...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know you're actually very considerate of others. I know this for a fact...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Your ideas sometimes sound crazy, but you take steps to make sure they're safe.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: As long as they trust you and follow your instructions, they'll be fine. I know this because we used to try your ideas when we were little.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: These shows mean everything to me. Nothing makes me happier than seeing you, Tsukasa and Emu having fun while bringing what I wrote to life.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's why the thought that I'm holding back doesn't make sense to me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I understand.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Rui, you feel like you've found a place where you belong.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You finally found a group of friends who let you unleash your full potential. Isn't this how you feel?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But you need to challenge yourself to make extraordinary performances! And I aim to be the world's greatest star!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If it's for the sake of entertaining my audience, I'll pull off even the most dangerous stunts with elegance and grace!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If it's to put on a good show, then I'll do anything!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Aaargh!!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It looks like you've figured it out.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes...
It started with that accident.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: On a subconscious level, I must have been so afraid that Tsukasa would start hating me and leave, like everyone else did...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Somewhere along the way, I started to press the brakes out of not wanting to lose what took me so long to find...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm honestly surprised.
This never occurred to me...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I disappointed my friends, who are working so hard, over these fears. I let them down as their director...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Rui, your concerns are nothing to be ashamed of.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'd like you lot to hear about this too.

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Us?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You genuinely love these shows, so it's only natural that you'd want to preserve this place you've found.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course, nobody wants to see their friends get hurt in the process.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But you all share the same goal of wanting to put on great shows that will delight your audience.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Which is why it becomes important to find a balance, so that you can all move ahead together.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sure Tsukasa will understand where you are coming from.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think so too...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
We can find a way to work things out.
I'm sure Tsukasa will come around too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
He's kind of a nutcase.
A show maniac if that even makes sense.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I mean... You're one too, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I doubt he'll turn his back on you like this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I really have found something special.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I need to make sure you guys can count on me.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Tsukasaaa! Calm down already...!
...Bwargh!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ugh... Don't stop so suddenly like that...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu, please tell me....

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Do you think Rui's shows are good?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I LOVE them!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They remind me of Grandpa's shows!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Like they're super exciting from start to finish, and make you feel all fuzzy inside!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Exactly, I like that about them too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And that's why I got so angry...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The four of us teamed up to create shows that are fun for everyone, but it was like Rui forgot what we were trying to achieve...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, it's not entirely his fault...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If that accident never happened, Rui wouldn't be like this now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You mean you weren't just mad at Rui?
You were mad at yourself too?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! I still am too! I killed the director's confidence, didn't I? I'm not a star, I'm a disgrace!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A real star inspires their director to entrust them with any role! To unleash their imagination and try new ideas!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe♪ There's the Tsukasa we all know and love!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, this is what I'm going to tell Rui tomorrow. The last time we spoke, I was at a loss for words...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm sure he'll hear you out!
The next day
Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay... I think I have everything I need for today.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, it's time to go and get to work on our show!
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hiii! Good morning, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Good morning, Emu.
I'm sorry about yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Don't worry about it!
I'm all good now...! Although...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, Rui...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui, about what happened yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa, do you mind helping me with something I'd like to try out?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What sort of thing?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It's a new idea for the show.
How about it?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Something new, eh?
Sounds interesting.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll take every necessary safety precaution, such as using a soft mat on the floor in case you fall...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nonetheless, things could still go wrong. You're already well aware that I tend to push each actor to their limits in my plays.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Would you be okay with that...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You already know the answer!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I don't call myself Tsukasa Tenma, future star, for nothing!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A-Are they going to be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...! It'll be fine...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's actually something I've been wanting to test for some time and thought it might be interesting to incorporate it into a show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What does this button do?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, press it and...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whoa, what the...? A wall's rising up at the back of the stage?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: W-When did you install this...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wooow! It's so tall!
It's almost up to the roof!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hm...? There's a ladder too!
You can climb up to the top!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Are you going to have Tsukasa climb that ladder...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, you read my mind, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll use this wall during the climax of our Halloween show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The scene where the park director is desperately trying to crawl out of the hole he fell into to escape the zombies.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I really want to make the finale as dramatic as possible, and the trap room wouldn't do this scene any justice.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, if we made it so that the audience could see what's happening inside the pit, then it would be a bit more interesting.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But how do you do that...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Gasp! Is the stage going to be the bottom of the pit?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Precisely!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll have the zombies chase Tsukasa, who'll fall into the trap room, but then the stage will go dark...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: While the lights are off, Tsukasa will need to climb back out and get to the top of the wall. We won't have much time here, so he'll have to be quick.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The lights will come back on just as Tsukasa jumps from the top and back onto the stage to fall into the pit.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He'll then have to climb the wall again to crawl out of the pit.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Again, he'll need to be quick or the zombie robots will pull him back down.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui, that's a fairly big wall. Isn't it a bit dangerous...? Having Tsukasa jump from all the way up there...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is going to be amazing!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Did you hear what I just said...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You make it sound easy, but you do realize that it's going to be pretty hard to climb that ladder in complete darkness, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And on top of that, the robots will be trying to stop me?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's right, but you're more than capable of doing this, yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, of course!
I was born to be a star after all.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Let's give it a go!
Ready your zombie robots for a test run!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Aaargh! I'm going to fall...!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Alright. It's a long way down but I can do it.
What the...?!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
This wind coming from below...!
What's with it...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
For enhanced realism!
Be careful you don't actually fall!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I-I wasn't expecting this!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He landed safely...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa, that was awesome!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, this is where it gets more challenging.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've fallen into a pit of some kind? There shouldn't be anything like this in my theme park...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?! It's crawling with zombies!
I don't want to turn into one of them!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'm not giving up yet!
I'll climb back up to the surface!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You have ten zombies coming after you here!
Can you make a safe escape?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hnnngh!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Climbing alone won't save you!
You have to fight to make it out!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Argh... Then how about THIS!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that's it! Shake them off and kick them back down into the pit! Can you handle them all?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's a piece of cake for me! Hyaaah!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You can do better than that!
Do it with more flair!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehehe♪
Rui's really enjoying himself now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, he is...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff... Huff... Huff...
I-I'm spent... No... More...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Good job, Tsukasa.
How did you like the new additions?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Honestly, I thought you were trying to kill me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But that was definitely an action-packed scene befitting of a future star such as myself! We're sure to receive a standing ovation!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, Rui! I want you to keep throwing your best ideas at me without holding back!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Just ask and I'll promise to deliver!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm pleased by your enthusiasm. I actually already have something in mind.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. So many ideas... Which one shall I start with...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, uh... Well, that's great but... You know, I'm happy with not-so-insanely-dangerous shows too...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's so liberating for a director to have a truly fearless actor at his disposal. Next, we'll need a water tank that you'll fit into...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Whoa, wait a minute!
What are you planning to use that for?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Isn't it great that they made up, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. They both seem much better now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm glad Rui feels so accepted here...
A few weeks later
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah hah!
Our Halloween show was a great success!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everyone was on the edge of their seats!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The Halloween theme and clever use of props turned out to be a real draw too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Indeed. Seeing everyone smile the way they did during the finale was particularly rewarding.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Miss Emu!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whoa! This dude keeps jumping out of nowhere...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, he's usually hiding in that bush over there.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
R-Really?
I had no idea.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: (I didn't think anyone would figure that out...)

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Ahem! More importantly, Miss Emu, the tallies for the first round of shows were announced today!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They already announced them?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, how are we doing?!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Ah, please take a look here.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's see... We're... Third!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Third is... Pretty good, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It is. Especially considering that the groups in first and second are on bigger stages. We're doing rather well.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We aren't that far behind the group in second either.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But there's a huge gap in score between us and the Phoenix Stage group in first place.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then we need to step up our game!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're going to win and star in that commercial!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm counting on you to come up with another amazing show, Mr. Director!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, of course. I'll chart us a course to reach new heights and see more smiles.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I also brought some props I'd like to try out for our next show. Would you mind helping me with them?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ah, so the pile of stuff behind the stage is yours.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I've never seen most of these props before! There was this outfit like a space suit and a gizmo that looked like a rocket...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're not planning on sending me into space, are you?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Follow me this way, Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, not so fast! I've got a bad feeling about this!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My idea with the water tank didn't pan out, so I thought that I'd try something in the sky instead...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What kind of logic is that?! And do you live in some warehouse filled with these insane things?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Why not come over and see for yourself...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No! No way you're going to lure me there!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I want to see Rui's house!
Let's all visit together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm NOT going!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sigh... Keep it down, will you guys...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But it's good to see that things are back to normal...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You know, Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes? What is it, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm happy.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm happy that we're making shows together again, just like when we were little.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, you are?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: There was a time when you were all alone and I had no way to help.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But it's different now. You can lean on me more. We've been friends since forever, so you can count on me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Thanks, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, let's go home already!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Why don't we have a party to celebrate our show's success like last time♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We can if you want to, but just try to keep the noise down.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, I suppose I could come along too. Oh, actually...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I should go over to SEKAI and give KAITO my thanks.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But that wouldn't make for much of a visit. It might be better to invite him to see our show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Seeing the fruits of our labor, a performance that makes everyone feel good, would be a better gift of gratitude than a few lousy words.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, what should we do for our next show?
bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: I want our next show to be stylish!

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Well, look at that. They've made up and are getting along just fine again!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Phew! That's one less worry♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: How did you make that happen, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We talked a little. That's all.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I wonder what kind of show Rui and his friends are making right now...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Something tells me they'll surprise us soon with another amazing performance...
